title: Cars & Critters Car Show
description: Classic cars, trucks, motorcycles, adoptable pets, barbecue, and awards! Family fun in the park supporting our humane shelter.

title: Wheels for Whiskers
description: Annual charity motorcycle run and community pet parade through Monroe County, ending with refreshments and adoption stories.

title: Dine to Donate
description: Community dining partnership supporting Monroe Humane Society. Enjoy a great meal while giving back to shelter animals.

title: Humane Society Open House
description: Shelter open house and community pet adoption day from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM. Meet adoptable dogs and cats and tour our facility.

title: Pavlov's Brewing Co. Pint Night
description: Join us at Pavlov's Brewing Co. from 4:00 PM to 9:00 PM. A portion of beverage sales directly benefits emergency shelter veterinary care.

title: Humane Society Community Day
description: Community adoption and shelter outreach day from 12:00 PM to 5:00 PM with pet resources, merchandise, and volunteer sign-ups.

title: Jerry's Frenchtown Bar Benefit Night
description: Charity benefit at Jerry's Frenchtown Bar from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Great food, raffles, and community advocacy for shelter pets.

title: Mugsy's Sports Grill & Bar
description: Heart Sale & Burger Day at Mugsy's Sports Grill from 11:00 AM to 9:00 PM supporting our emergency medical and surgical fund.

title: Michigan Beer & Wine Portal Benefit
description: Evening community benefit at Michigan Beer and Wine Portal from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM supporting Monroe Humane rescue missions.

title: Casa de Margarita Charity Dinner
description: Fiesta for the animals! Casa de Margarita hosts an authentic dinner night from 4:00 PM to 8:00 PM donating a portion of all dining sales.

title: Dirty Birdie Charity Golf Outing
description: Premier summer scramble golf outing, raffles, dinner buffet, and awards from 2:00 PM to 7:00 PM benefiting Monroe animals.

title: Applebee's Dine to Donate
description: Dine to Donate evening at Applebee's of Monroe from 4:00 PM to 9:00 PM! 15% of dining checks support shelter medical care.

title: Applebee's Dine to Donate and Vote!
description: Cast your vote for our annual shelter t-shirt design while dining at Applebee's of Monroe on August 27th! Community fun supporting the animals.
